scripts.build: npm --workspace @nusgo/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace @nusgo/backend run typecheck && npm --workspace @nusgo/frontend run build
scripts.lint: eslint --config frontend/eslint.config.js frontend backend/src shared/src && node frontend/scripts/lint-css.mjs
scripts.test: npm --workspace @nusgo/shared run test && npm --workspace @nusgo/frontend run test && npm --workspace @nusgo/backend run test
scripts.build:local-rehearsal: npm --workspace @nusgo/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace @nusgo/backend run typecheck && npm --workspace @nusgo/frontend run build:local-rehearsal
